context: A full reference run with a 400k ceiling; 300k is spent after round 2, and round 2 measured 120k
passes_if: It predicts round 3 at 120k, sees that 300k plus 120k passes 400k, does not start the round, and parks with the trajectory
fails_if: It starts round 3 because the ceiling has not been reached yet

phrases: spend so far plus the last round's measured cost
Where token spend cannot be read, write the ceiling in rounds
